description: This file is a shell test script for verifying the behavior of the 'git clone' command, especially how it interacts with custom SSH commands and the 'git-upload-pack' command.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes the provided commands, and handles setup or validation.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail; used here to test error scenarios.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files or strings to verify they are identical.
